tips.text: Train from Vienna (Wien Hbf) to Nickelsdorf takes ~45 min. Direct regional services run during festival.
Dedicated shuttle buses from Nickelsdorf station to festival grounds run continuously.
Driving: Nickelsdorf is directly off the A4 motorway. Follow festival signage for parking fields.
Nova Rock is 100% cashless — no cash or cards accepted inside the festival grounds.
Top up your PlayPass wristband online before arrival to avoid queues at the gate.
Top-up stations available at festival entrance but expect queues especially Thursday.
The Pannonia Fields site is flat and exposed — wind can be brutal. Bring tent pegs and a mallet.
Eco Green Camping (new 2026): eco-friendly zone with recycling stations and solar-powered lighting.
Festival medical centre is marked on the map. Free first aid available.
